scope: Genuine ordinary-Calc TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ over proven same-operator DECIMAL ABS/negation and same-scale widening, literal precision 0/3. Mixed unary, arithmetic, runtime precision and UNNEST retain preceding routes.
released_contract: Truncate DECIMAL toward zero, wrap low signed 64 bits, wrapping multiply by 1000 for seconds, then bound final milliseconds. Decimal seconds has no original-unit bound. NULL propagates.
